name: Privacy.com Virtual Card
author: hearth-team
description: Agent-issued virtual cards via Privacy.com. Mint single-use or merchant-locked cards with hard spend caps, freeze/unfreeze/close, update limits, list transactions. Bring your own PRIVACY_API_KEY. US-only. Card numbers are NEVER returned to chat — mint yields the card token + last four; the founder retrieves full details in the Privacy.com dashboard or via the purchase rail.

family.name: Payments Family
family.description: Agent-controlled payment surfaces — Privacy.com virtual cards now; Lemon Squeezy + Stripe Connect later.

vault_inputs.label: Privacy.com API Key
vault_inputs.help: From privacy.com → Account → Developers → Generate API Key. Stored encrypted in vault.

vault_inputs.label: Default spend cap per card (USD)
vault_inputs.help: Even if the agent requests a higher amount, mint will hard-cap at this value. Default: $50.

vault_inputs.label: Approval-required threshold (USD)
vault_inputs.help: Mint requests above this amount queue an approval card before the API call fires. Default: $25.

verbs.description: Mint a new virtual card. Args: spend_limit_usd (required), memo (required, what's it for), type ('SINGLE_USE'|'MERCHANT_LOCKED' default MERCHANT_LOCKED), spend_limit_duration ('TRANSACTION' default |'MONTHLY'|'ANNUALLY'|'FOREVER'). Returns card_token + last_four — the full card number and CVV are withheld from chat by design.
List active + recently-paused cards. Returns [{token, last_four, memo, spend_limit, state}].
Resume a paused card (state=OPEN). Args: card_token (required).
PERMANENTLY close a card (state=CLOSED, cannot be undone). Args: card_token (required), confirm (must be true). Prefer freeze for anything reversible.
Update spend cap on an existing card. Args: card_token, spend_limit_usd.

List recent transactions. Args: card_token (optional, filter), begin/end (YYYY-MM-DD, optional), result ('APPROVED'|'DECLINED', optional), page (optional). Returns [{token, amount_usd, merchant, status, result, created}].
